chapter_title: Generation Methods: Bootstrap, Evol, Extraction, Persona, Rephrase
course_outline_concepts: Bootstrap lineage: Self-Instruct (Wang 2022, Yejin Choi group) seed+sample+filter loop; Alpaca's cheap replication
Evolution operators: Evol-Instruct depth + breadth, WizardMath/Coder specialisations
Aligned-model extraction: Magpie prefix-only sampling — no seed, no API
Persona-conditioned synthesis: Persona-Hub's 1B personas as a diversity operator
Web rephrasing: WRAP — why a small model can turn raw web into Q&A and beat raw web at equal tokens

sources.what_to_extract: Four-stage pipeline (seed → instruction gen → classification branching → instance gen → filter); 175-seed pool; ROUGE-L > 0.7 dedup threshold; 52K instructions × 82K instances from ~252K raw; verbatim instruction-generation prompt template.
Simplified Self-Instruct replication on LLaMA 7B with text-davinci-003; ~$500 data generation cost; teacher dependency and license constraints; the bridge to open synthetic SFT.

Five In-Depth operators (add constraints, deepening, concretizing, increased reasoning steps, complicate input) + one In-Breadth operator; 4-round pipeline from 52K Alpaca seeds to ~250K evolved; elimination filters; verbatim operator prompts.
Bidirectional math evolution (downward + upward); RLEIF with IRM × PRM and PPO; GSM8K/MATH seeds; 70B results vs GPT-3.5/Claude 2.
Five code-specialized operators; 20K Code-Alpaca seeds → ~78K evolved pairs; HumanEval 57.3 with 15B; decontamination requirement.
Operator reference organized by axes (complexity / scope / reasoning depth / robustness / domain); M=3 iterations per seed; Magicoder-Evol-Instruct-110K as public reproduction.
Pre-query template prefix-only extraction; MAGPIE-Air 3M / MAGPIE-Pro 1M scale; 206 / 614 GPU hours; eight filtering metrics; tau1=-12, tau2=0 thresholds; <1% harmful flag rate.

1,015,863,523 personas after MinHash 0.9 + embedding 0.9 dedup; Text-to-Persona + Persona-to-Persona 6-round expansion; zero-shot vs few-shot vs persona-enhanced few-shot; Qwen2-7B 64.9% MATH with 1.07M synthetic problems; output similarity < persona similarity.
~300-token chunk size; Mistral-7B-Instruct teacher; four styles (Easy/Wikipedia/Terse/Q-A); 1:1 real:synthetic mixing; ~3x compute speedup; 350M with 15% C4 beats 1.3B on full C4.
Instruction backtranslation as inverse of Self-Instruct: text → instruction rather than instruction → text; self-curation loop; web-grounded alignment without proprietary teacher.
